title: Aztec Launches Tierra Upgrade, Patching Critical Flaw in Privacy Network
description: Aztec's Tierra upgrade fixes a critical V5 proving flaw, adds formal verification of its cryptography and cuts Ethereum-to-Aztec message delivery from two minutes to as little as 12 seconds.

title: South Korea's president orders a review of a government-wide cybersecurity czar
description: President Lee Jae Myung told a Cabinet meeting on Nov. 3 that South Korea should consider a cybersecurity czar agency to coordinate security work split across government, citing the $6.3 billion Binance theft and a wave of domestic breaches.

title: CFTC clears stock perpetual futures as an industry group sues to stop them
description: The CFTC said equity perpetual futures can trade on US exchanges for the first time on Nov. 3, and the Capital Markets Alliance sued the same day, losing its bid for an emergency halt.

title: LDK Patch Blocks Probe Linking Private Channels to Their Funding Output
description: A merged LDK pull request stops onion-message forwarding from resolving real short-channel IDs for unannounced channels, closing a probe that could tie hidden channels to onchain outputs.

title: Liquid Network restores full bitcoin backing two months after exploit
description: The Liquid Federation said its bitcoin reserves now back every LBTC one for one, closing the roughly 600 BTC shortfall left by the September exploit, while direct federation peg-outs stay restricted.
